problem:
$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}7 & -15 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}]x(t)
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above.
Find the unknown function $f(t)$ in the general solution to the system, shown below.

$$
\text{x}(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}f(t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(6t)\end{aligned}]{e}^{4t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡(6t)+2\operatorname{cos}⁡(6t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(6t)\end{aligned}]{e}^{4t}
$$

*Hint: The matrix has the eigenvalue ${\lambda }_{1}=4+6\text{i}$ with the corresponding eigenvector ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1+2\text{i} \\ 1\end{aligned}].$*
